priorityList: Apply poisons and enter Stealth before combat.
Use Shadow Blades when Shadow Dance and Secret Technique are both ready.
Use Shadow Dance if Secret Technique is ready or if Darkest Night is active (ensure at least 30 Energy).
Use Vanish to generate Combo Points if not in Stealth and at 1 or 0 Combo Points.
Use Shadowstrike if Darkest Night is active and Shadow Techniques has 5+ stacks to maximize Combo Point generation.
Spend Combo Points at maximum (6-7) or 1 less than maximum if Darkest Night is active.
Use Secret Technique as your priority finisher if Shadow Dance is active.
Use Eviscerate as a finisher if Darkest Night is active.
Use Coup de Grace as a finisher if Shadow Dance is active or if Secret Technique is on cooldown (>= 3s).
Use Eviscerate as a finisher if Shadow Dance/Shadow Blades is active or if Secret Technique is on cooldown (>= 3s).
Use Shadowstrike as your primary builder while Stealthed or during Shadow Dance.
Use Goremaw's Bite if you need 3 or more Combo Points.
Use Gloomblade (or Backstab) to build Combo Points when not in Stealth or Shadow Dance.
Use offensive trinkets and racial abilities during Shadow Blades and Shadow Dance windows.
Use Arcane Torrent if energy is low to help smooth the rotation.
